title: Carbonara (Authentic) Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 75g pecorino cheese + some extra for garnish
instructions: Start cooking some spaghetti in less water then usual.
Fry the chopped up bacon, no oils added, until crispy.
In a bowl, beat together the egg yolks and whole eggs. Add grated cheese and pepper and mix well.
Remove bacon from the heat and wait a bit for it to not be scorching hot.
Take a bit of spaghetti water and add it into egg mixture in order to temper it a bit.
Add spaghetti and egg mixture into the pan and keep stirring so the egg does not clump, until creamy and glossy.
